caption: One Billing class doing four jobs has cohesion 1; split into four single-job classes plus Billing as controller, it becomes five classes, each scoring 7. Billing's call to GstCalculator crosses only simple data (score 5), while the call to BillRepository carries the whole Bill object (stamp, score 4) until only billId and amount are passed.

spec.aria: A single Billing class with cohesion 1 is split into GstCalculator, ReceiptPrinter, BillRepository and SmsNotifier, each with cohesion 7, with Billing kept as a controller calling all four; the call to GstCalculator is data coupling scoring 5 and the call to BillRepository is stamp coupling scoring 4.
